newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia saint stolen, faithful threaten to starve.
newsitem.headline: Colombia saint stolen, faithful threaten to starve.

text.p: Church-goers in a northern Colombian town threatened to stage a mass hunger strike on Monday after thieves stole their patron saint, television reported.

Worshippers in San Cayetano, the town named after the saint said to provide food, packed into the humble parish church and said they would starve themselves unless the evil-doers returned the stolen statuette.
"These bad people must bring San Cayetano back; otherwise God will certainly punish them," one Catholic worshipper in the town in Bolivar province told the Noticiero Nacional news programme.
"We will stay in this church and go on hunger strike unless we get our saint back," another woman said.
Sixteen churches have been robbed in the area in recent weeks, according to Noticiero Nacional.
